parameters.help_en: The signature name. This parameter is required. Maximum length: 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 签名名称。非空，最长128字符
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en: The OSS key of the material file. After you obtain the OSS configuration by calling the GetOSSInfoForUploadFile operation and upload the file directly, pass in the returned ossKey. This parameter is required. Maximum length: 512 characters
parameters.help_zh: 素材文件OSS Key。通过GetOSSInfoForUploadFile接口获取OSS配置后直传文件，将返回的ossKey传入。非空，最长512字符
parameters.name: asset_file_oss_key

parameters.help_en:
The type of the material file. This parameter is required. Valid values:

1: Image. Supported formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, and GIF. Maximum size: 20 MB.
2: Audio. Supported formats: AMR, MP3, M4A, and AAC. Maximum size: 20 MB.
3: Video. Supported formats: 3GP, MP4, and WEBM. Maximum size: 20 MB
parameters.help_zh:
素材文件类型，非空。取值：

1：图片。支持JPG、JPEG、PNG、BMP、GIF格式，最大20MB。
2：音频。支持AMR、MP3、M4A、AAC格式，最大20MB。
3：视频。支持3GP、MP4、WEBM格式，最大20MB
parameters.name: asset_file_type

parameters.help_en: The OSS key of the thumbnail file. This parameter is optional for image types but required for audio and video types. Supported formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, and BMP. Maximum size: 10 KB. Maximum length: 512 characters
parameters.help_zh: 缩略图文件OSS Key。图片类型可选，音频/视频类型必传。支持格式JPG/JPEG/PNG/BMP，最大10KB，最长512字符
parameters.name: thumbnail_file_oss_key
